name: Antarctic Navigation Crisis Demo
description: Scripted 6-hour scenario showing risk escalation and successful rerouting

steps.title: Departure - All Clear

reasons: Low risk - Continue with standard monitoring

steps.message: Route A initiated. Weather favorable. All systems nominal.

steps.title: New Iceberg Detected

reasons: New iceberg A85-NEW detected: 18.2 km away
Satellite imagery shows calving event from larger berg

steps.message: Satellite alert: New iceberg detected on route. Risk elevated to YELLOW. Monitoring drift.

steps.title: Route A Blocked - High Risk

reasons: High risk - Monitor closely and prepare evasive action
Predicted drift cone blocks Route A in 2 hours
Ocean currents pushing iceberg toward shipping lane

steps.message: ORANGE ALERT: Route A predicted blocked. Physics model shows 72h drift cone intersects planned path. Calculating Route B.

steps.title: Crisis Averted - Route B

reasons: Low risk - Continue with standard monitoring
Route B adds 12 km but maintains >15 km safety buffer

steps.message: Reroute successful. Risk reduced to GREEN. ETA adjusted +1.2 hours. Crisis management effective.
